title: Get Products Shared Properties
description: Declarations of the get_products response fields that the completed and rejected bodies both carry. Each body declares these fields by reference to this document.

targeting_resolution.description: Request-level confirmation of structured hard targeting inferred from the brief. Sellers MUST include this when their structured interpretation of hard prose materially affects product eligibility, pricing, or forecasting; otherwise inclusion is a best practice. Omitted when no hard targeting was inferred from the brief.

extensions.description: Bundled platform-extension definitions referenced by any product in `products`. Keyed by `<extension_uri>@<digest>` (e.g., `https://creative.adcontextprotocol.org/translated/meta/extensions/meta_pixel@sha256:abc...`). When present, lets buyers resolve `platform_extensions` references on product format declarations without a separate fetch. Buyer SDKs cache by URI@digest; subsequent get_products responses MAY omit definitions the buyer already has cached and rely on the digest match. Each value is an extension definition with `extends` (the canonical concept it extends, e.g., `tracking`), `fields` (the schema for additional fields the extension contributes), `version`, and optional `description`.

fields.description: JSON Schema fragment declaring the additional fields this extension contributes.

version.description: Semantic version of the extension definition. Distinct from the digest — version is human-readable; digest is the integrity check.

property_list_applied.description: [AdCP 3.0] Indicates whether deprecated top-level property_list filtering was applied. True if the agent filtered products based on the provided property_list; every returned product also carries the corresponding property/include list_applications receipt. Absent or false if property_list was not provided or not supported by this agent.

catalog_applied.description: Whether the seller filtered results based on the provided catalog. True if the seller matched catalog items against its inventory. Absent or false if no catalog was provided or the seller does not support catalog matching.

execution_readiness.description: Experimental (`media_buy.execution_readiness`). Whether the request's `account` can satisfy the `execution_requirements[]` of the products on this response, keyed by `product_id`. Present only when the request set `include_execution_readiness: true` and carried an authorized `account`. Advisory: `create_media_buy` revalidates. Not part of the cache layer: it does not change `cache_scope`, `wholesale_feed_version`, or `pricing_version`, buyers key it by (account, `version`) and MUST NOT cache it under the public key, sellers MUST NOT put it in wholesale feed webhooks and MUST omit it on `unchanged: true` responses. Covers only this response's products; merge pages by `product_id`. See the media-buy specification, 'Per-account execution readiness'.

version.description: Opaque token for the account's readiness state, independent of `wholesale_feed_version` and `pricing_version`. Compare for equality only. Equal versions MUST imply identical entries for any product present in both responses.

evaluated_at.description: When the seller read the account's resources. Readiness may be stale by then; `create_media_buy` is authoritative.

products.description: Readiness keyed by `product_id`, for returned products that declare `execution_requirements`. A missing entry means not evaluated, not ready.

sandbox.description: When true, this response contains simulated data from sandbox mode.
